mentions.description: A Terraform Provider Network Mirror, with the goal of growing into a generic proxy cache for packages and artifacts across other ecosystems such as npm, PyPI, Maven, NuGet, and container images.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A Terraform Provider Network Mirror.

My idea is this project to grow into a more generic proxy cache for packages/artifacts for other ecosystems: npm, pypi, maven, nuget, container images.
